spells.name: Dawnfire
spells.description: Lv. 10 single-target Light spell (2s cast, 6s recast, requires Staff). Fast, reliable core spell for steady melee-casting cycles.

spells.name: Sunbrand
spells.description: Lv. 30 single-target Light spell (2.5s cast, 8s recast, requires Staff). Mid-weight Light nuke for heavier pressure.

spells.name: Last Light
spells.description: Lv. 50 single-target Light finisher (3.5s cast, 14s recast, requires Staff) that intensifies further at Lv. 70. Ideal to pair with Consecration.

spells.name: Pillar of Day
spells.description: Lv. 50 single-target Light spell (3s cast, 12s recast, requires Staff). High-impact Light burst for sustained openings.

spells.name: Vigil Lance
spells.description: Lv. 10 single-target Light spell (15 MP, 2.5s cast, 15s recast). Provides offensive pressure between Escort rescues and lets you practice self-Wingmate timing.

spells.name: Ancient Invocation
spells.description: Lv. 10 single-target Ancient Magic (4.5s cast, 18s shared Ancient recovery). Unleashes the element of your last damaging probe (defaulting to Earth).

spells.name: Bedrock
spells.description: Lv. 10 Earth probe (4 MP, 1.5s cast, 3s recast). Dealing damage aligns Ancient Invocation to Earth.

spells.name: Cinder
spells.description: Lv. 10 Fire probe (6 MP, 1.5s cast, 3s recast). Dealing damage aligns Ancient Invocation to Fire.

spells.name: Gale
spells.description: Lv. 10 Wind probe (6 MP, 1.5s cast, 3s recast). Dealing damage aligns Ancient Invocation to Wind.

spells.name: Rime
spells.description: Lv. 10 Ice probe (8 MP, 1.5s cast, 3s recast). Dealing damage aligns Ancient Invocation to Ice.

spells.name: Static Spark
spells.description: Lv. 10 Thunder probe (9 MP, 1.5s cast, 3s recast). Dealing damage aligns Ancient Invocation to Thunder.

spells.name: Tsunami
spells.description: Lv. 10 Water probe (5 MP, 1.5s cast, 3s recast). Dealing damage aligns Ancient Invocation to Water.

spells.name: Elemental Survey
spells.description: Lv. 30 diagnostic spell (1s cast, 30s recast). Reads the target's lowest resistance ranks across all six probe elements.

spells.name: Starway
spells.description: Lv. 30 utility spell (100 MP, 4s cast, 10s recast). Out-of-combat astral travel back to your home point.

spells.name: Rimefall
spells.description: Lv. 50 fixed-element Ice Ancient Magic (7s cast, 18s shared Ancient recovery). Grows stronger at Lv. 70.

spells.name: Skybreak
spells.description: Lv. 50 fixed-element Wind Ancient Magic (7s cast, 18s shared Ancient recovery). Grows stronger at Lv. 70.

spells.name: Solar Collapse
spells.description: Lv. 50 fixed-element Fire Ancient Magic (7s cast, 18s shared Ancient recovery). Grows stronger at Lv. 70.

spells.name: Thunderstar
spells.description: Lv. 50 fixed-element Thunder Ancient Magic (7s cast, 18s shared Ancient recovery). Grows stronger at Lv. 70.

spells.name: Tidal Cataclysm
spells.description: Lv. 50 fixed-element Water Ancient Magic (7s cast, 18s shared Ancient recovery). Grows stronger at Lv. 70.

spells.name: Worldsplitter
spells.description: Lv. 50 fixed-element Earth Ancient Magic (7s cast, 18s shared Ancient recovery). Grows stronger at Lv. 70.

spells.name: Conduit Bolt
spells.description: Lv. 10 single-target offensive spell (9 MP, 2s cast, 4s recast). Reliable filler damage between Conduit Link windows.

spells.name: Aether Tap
spells.description: Lv. 30 MP-siphon spell (10 MP, 3s cast, 60s recast). Drains MP from enemies that possess an MP pool.

spells.name: Break Stride
spells.description: Arbiter enfeeble (Lv. 10, 20s recast) that slows enemy attack speed and prepares an Advance order on landing.

spells.name: Obscure Aim
spells.description: Arbiter enfeeble (Lv. 10, 10s recast) that lowers enemy accuracy and prepares a Recompose order on landing.

spells.name: Quiet Front
spells.description: Arbiter enfeeble (Lv. 10, 10s recast) that suppresses enemy casting and prepares a Recompose order on landing.

spells.name: Seize Initiative
spells.description: Arbiter enfeeble (Lv. 10, 10s recast) that hinders enemy actions and prepares an Advance order on landing.

spells.name: Unravel Defense
spells.description: Arbiter dispel (Lv. 30, 10s recast) that removes an enemy enhancement and reopens your most recently issued order (or Advance if none has been issued).

spells.name: Copper Stitch
spells.description: Starter earth weave spell (Lv. 10, 1.5s cast, 3s recast) empowered while in Yin form.

spells.name: Gale Needle
spells.description: Starter wind weave spell (Lv. 10, 1.5s cast, 3s recast) empowered while in Yin form.

spells.name: Rime Stitch
spells.description: Starter ice weave spell (Lv. 10, 1.5s cast, 3s recast) empowered while in Yin form.

spells.name: Searing Needle
spells.description: Starter fire weave spell (Lv. 10, 1.5s cast, 3s recast) empowered while in Yin form.

spells.name: Storm Needle
spells.description: Starter lightning weave spell (Lv. 10, 1.5s cast, 3s recast) empowered while in Yin form.

spells.name: Tide Stitch
spells.description: Starter water weave spell (Lv. 10, 1.5s cast, 3s recast) empowered while in Yin form.

spells.name: Scarlet Spindle
spells.description: Mid-tier single-target fire weave spell (Lv. 30, 2s cast, 6s recast) empowered while in Yin form.

spells.name: Violet Shuttle
spells.description: High-tier single-target lightning weave spell (Lv. 50, 2.4s cast, 7s recast) empowered while in Yin form.

spells.name: Tempest Loom
spells.description: Heavy single-target wind weave spell (Lv. 70, 3s cast, 12s recast) empowered while in Yin form.

spells.name: Ashen Judgment
spells.description: Oathbreaker ranged single-target light spell (Lv. 10, 15 MP, 2s cast, 15s recast).

spells.name: Grave Toll
spells.description: Ranged single-target dark magic spell (Lv. 10, 12 MP, 1.5s cast, 12s recast) that deals significantly increased damage during enemy Recovery without healing or consuming Finality's opening.

spells.name: Ash
spells.description: Curses a single enemy (10 MP, 12s shared recast, up to 24s) to weaken its qualifying direct damaging spells; against dark-immune targets, can leave a brief 8s single-use ward.

spells.name: Withering
spells.description: Curses a single enemy (10 MP, 12s shared recast, up to 24s) to weaken its qualifying physical and ranged special techniques; against dark-immune targets, can leave a brief 8s single-use ward.

spells.name: Famine
spells.description: Unlocks at Lv. 30. Curses a single enemy (10 MP, 12s shared recast, up to 24s) to reduce its qualifying combat self-healing; against dark-immune targets, can leave a brief 8s single-use ward.

spells.name: Crosscut
spells.description: Lv. 10 zero-tool squad command (14s recast): orders your shadow clones to deliver rapid single-target strikes.

spells.name: False Assault
spells.description: Lv. 10 zero-tool squad command (12s recast): executes a feint strike and opens a 12s Opening window that empowers your next different squad command.

spells.name: Mirror Step
spells.description: Lv. 10 zero-tool squad command (16s recast): initiates a 10s alternating fast-and-heavy strike cadence that scales with your active squad size.

spells.name: Shadow Squadron: Ichi
spells.description: Lv. 10 zero-tool Ninjutsu (20s recast): summons 2 offensive shadow clones (up to 5 active, 25-30s lifetime) that independently attack your engaged target.

spells.name: Shadow Pin
spells.description: Lv. 30 zero-tool squad command (18s recast): locks onto the target for 12s with heightened Accuracy and melee pressure while extending your active tactical phase.

spells.name: Shadow Squadron: Ni
spells.description: Lv. 37 zero-tool Ninjutsu (30s recast): summons 3 offensive shadow clones (up to 5 active, 25-30s lifetime) that independently attack your engaged target.

spells.name: Thunder Relay
spells.description: Lv. 50 zero-tool squad command (22s recast): triggers an escalating sequential relay attack across 2 or more living clones.

spells.name: Final Mirage
spells.description: Lv. 70 zero-tool squad command (45s recast): high-commitment finisher that consumes your current tactical phase for a decisive squad strike.

spells.name: Blunting Seal
spells.description: Lv. 10 zero-tool reactive seal (0 MP, 15y range, 20s shared recast / 18s at Lv. 50+): answers a telegraphed physical enemy technique to dampen its damage across your party, with a 3s retry on mismatch.

spells.name: Severing Seal
spells.description: Lv. 10 zero-tool reactive seal (0 MP, 15y range, 20s shared recast / 18s at Lv. 50+): interrupts susceptible enemy spell casts on a full landing or reduces the spell's direct damage if it completes, with a 3s retry on mismatch.

spells.name: Signal Flare
spells.description: Lv. 10 zero-tool Ninjutsu (0 MP, 10s recast): quick single-target fire filler spell for dealing damage between enemy telegraphs.

spells.name: Call Carbuncle
spells.description: Lv. 10 (5 MP, 5s recast): summons Carbuncle to channel Light-elemental single-target pacts and Challenge Aspect windows.

spells.name: Call Ifrit
spells.description: Lv. 10 (5 MP, 5s recast): summons Ifrit to channel Fire-elemental single-target pacts and Challenge Aspect windows.

spells.name: Call Garuda
spells.description: Lv. 30 Prime attunement / Lv. 50 full roster (5 MP, 5s recast): summons Garuda for Wind-elemental single-target pacts.

spells.name: Call Leviathan
spells.description: Lv. 30 Prime attunement / Lv. 50 full roster (5 MP, 5s recast): summons Leviathan for Water-elemental single-target pacts.

spells.name: Call Ramuh
spells.description: Lv. 30 Prime attunement / Lv. 50 full roster (5 MP, 5s recast): summons Ramuh for Lightning-elemental single-target pacts.

spells.name: Call Shiva
spells.description: Lv. 30 Prime attunement / Lv. 50 full roster (5 MP, 5s recast): summons Shiva for Ice-elemental single-target pacts.

spells.name: Call Titan
spells.description: Lv. 30 Prime attunement / Lv. 50 full roster (5 MP, 5s recast): summons Titan for Earth-elemental single-target pacts.

spells.name: Invite Carbuncle
spells.description: Calls forth Carbuncle as your Light-element envoy (5 MP, 5s recast, Lv. 10).

spells.name: Invite Ifrit
spells.description: Calls forth Ifrit as your Fire-element envoy (5 MP, 5s recast, Lv. 10).

spells.name: Invite Garuda
spells.description: Calls forth Garuda as your Wind-element envoy (5 MP, 5s recast, Lv. 30).

spells.name: Invite Shiva
spells.description: Calls forth Shiva as your Ice-element envoy (5 MP, 5s recast, Lv. 30).

spells.name: Invite Leviathan
spells.description: Calls forth Leviathan as your Water-element envoy (5 MP, 5s recast, Lv. 50).

spells.name: Invite Ramuh
spells.description: Calls forth Ramuh as your Lightning-element envoy (5 MP, 5s recast, Lv. 50).

spells.name: Invite Titan
spells.description: Calls forth Titan as your Earth-element envoy (5 MP, 5s recast, Lv. 50).

spells.name: Briar Hammer
spells.description: Single-target blunt Blue Magic strike for Assimilator (6 MP, 7s recast, Lv. 10).

spells.name: Needle Lunge
spells.description: Single-target piercing Blue Magic strike for Assimilator (5 MP, 7s recast, Lv. 10).

spells.name: Razor Heel
spells.description: Single-target slashing Blue Magic strike for Assimilator (5 MP, 7s recast, Lv. 10).

spells.name: Iron Cleave
spells.description: Heavy single-target slashing Blue Magic strike for Assimilator (24 MP, 13s recast, Lv. 30).

spells.name: Skullbreaker Volley
spells.description: Three-hit single-target blunt Blue Magic strike for Assimilator (16 MP, 12s recast, Lv. 30).

spells.name: Ember Charge
spells.description: Single-target Fire elemental Blue Magic spell for Assimilator (26 MP, 16s recast, Lv. 50).

spells.name: Gale Knuckle
spells.description: Upgraded three-hit single-target blunt Blue Magic strike for Assimilator (28 MP, 16s recast, Lv. 50).

spells.name: Serrated Bite
spells.description: Upgraded single-target slashing Blue Magic strike for Assimilator (25 MP, 17s recast, Lv. 50).

spells.name: Furnace Breath
spells.description: High-impact single-target Fire elemental Blue Magic spell for Assimilator (36 MP, 20s recast, Lv. 70).

spells.name: Guillotine Shears
spells.description: High-impact single-target slashing Blue Magic finisher for Assimilator (32 MP, 20s recast, Lv. 70).

spells.name: Storm Gaze
spells.description: High-impact single-target Lightning elemental Blue Magic spell for Assimilator (30 MP, 18s recast, Lv. 70).

spells.name: File Countermeasure
spells.description: 0 MP, 15s recast (15y range expanding to 20y at Lv. 30): files a one-use countermeasure on yourself or a party member that reduces damage from the exact recorded enemy action for 20s (25s at Lv. 70+).

spells.name: Margin Note
spells.description: 4 MP, 0.5s cast, 6s recast: quick single-target earth spell used as filler between Record observations and countermeasure filings.

spells.name: Lay Meridian
spells.description: 0 MP, 18s recast: places a fixed meridian anchor at your current location for 30s (40s at Lv. 70+). Step 3–15y away to form an active accuracy corridor for party members along the line.

spells.name: Ley Spark
spells.description: 4 MP, 5s recast: single-target earth filler spell for contributing damage while holding corridor alignment.

spells.name: Shallow Fault
spells.description: 8s shared recast (18y range, 2s fuse): arms a single-target earthen fault beneath a claimed quarry for earth damage if the original target stays within 3y horizontally and vertically.

spells.name: Stone Chip
spells.description: 3 MP, 4s recast: quick single-target earth spell used to claim targets and weave damage between fault eruptions.

spells.name: Deep Fault
spells.description: Unlocks at Lv. 30 (8s shared recast, 18y range, 4s fuse): arms a heavier, longer-fuse earthen fault beneath a claimed quarry for major single-target earth damage if the target holds position.

spells.name: Runic Bolt
spells.description: Lv. 10 arcane Great Sword spell (2s base cast, 8s recast, 10y, requires Great Sword and active Rune). Scales with Runes and Conduction, cutting cast time and MP cost while boosting damage per stack.

spells.name: Runic Sever
spells.description: Lv. 55 heavy arcane finisher spell (3s base cast, 30s recast, 10y, requires Great Sword and active Rune). Scales with Runes and Conduction and excels on Magic Bursts.
